name: Presidency Division
description: The administrative central division of Bengal Proper surrounding the provincial capital, Calcutta. Encompassed the lower Ganges delta, Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system, and western Sundarbans.

name: Burdwan Division
description: The western division of Bengal Proper lying west of the Bhagirathi-Hooghly river. Featured the rich agricultural plains of Hooghly and Burdwan alongside the coalfields of Raniganj and Asansol.

name: Rajshahi Division
description: North Bengal division stretching from the Ganges river up to the Himalayan foothills of Darjeeling and the tea-growing Western Duars.

name: Dacca Division
description: The heartland of Eastern Bengal along the confluence of the Ganges (Padma), Brahmaputra (Jamuna), and Meghna rivers. Famous for jute cultivation, muslin heritage, and dense population.

name: Chittagong Division
description: South-eastern coastal and maritime division bordering Burma and the Bay of Bengal, featuring major sea trade routes and indigenous hill tracts.

name: Patna Division
description: The fertile Gangetic valley division of Bihar, encompassing ancient seats of power at Pataliputra, Mithila, and Buxar.

name: Bhagalpur Division
description: Eastern Bihar division straddling the Ganges, extending south into the Santal Parganas tribal uplands and north to Purnea.

name: Orissa Division
description: Coastal and inland division of Orissa, including the holy city of Jagannath Puri, ancient deltaic Cuttack, and 24 feudatory tributary states.

name: Chota Nagpur Division
description: Mineral-rich forested plateau division populated by Munda, Oraon, and Santhal indigenous communities, containing major coal reserves.
